topic: Can the filter's suppression of 19th harmonics improve transponder power efficiency in dense payload configurations?
consensus_response: Filtering out 19th harmonics through specific constellation sizes (e.g., 4+12 APSK) and pre-distortion techniques mitigates non-linear distortion in high-power amplifiers, reducing ISI and ACI. This improves spectral efficiency, leading to higher throughput and reduced latency.  The choice of filter design and amplifier linearity are critical for achieving optimal performance in dense payloads.
